title: Israel Threatens to Strip 'NAZA' Filmmakers of Their Citizenship
deck: A Venice-winning documentary accusing Israel's military of AI-targeted bombardment of Gaza has set off a political firestorm.
paragraphs: Israel is in uproar tonight. A single documentary has detonated a political firestorm. And the two Israeli filmmakers behind it now face an extraordinary threat: the loss of their own citizenship.
The film is called NAZA. It won a special jury prize at the Venice Film Festival. And it makes a devastating charge: that Israel's military used AI targeting to bombard Gaza.
The backlash was instant. Culture minister Miki Zohar calls it treason. He wants the directors stripped of their citizenship. And Prime Minister Netanyahu now vows to write that into law.
Directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor refuse to back down. They plan to screen the film inside Israel. Tonight, the fight over who tells the story of this war is only beginning.
